# Rebecca 1.7.1

Rebecca 1.7.1 fixes admin sessions and the dashboard reload after a panel update, and adds the ability to apply Xray routing, outbound, and balancer changes to matching custom nodes.

## Highlights

- 🔐 **Sessions last 90 days** — an admin session ends 90 days after login, or when the user logs out or changes the password. Restarts, updates, and reboots no longer end sessions, and sessions are no longer ended by 24 hours of inactivity.
- 🛡️ **New devices** — for 24 hours after login, a new device cannot change the account password or log out other devices from My Account. This does not apply when it is the only device on the account.
- 🔄 **Smoother panel updates** — the dashboard reloads only after the panel is ready, and a brief backend error no longer sends the user to the login page.
- 🧩 **Custom node changes** — a routing rule, outbound, or balancer edit can also be applied to the custom nodes that have the same item, from a Target tab in the same dialog. Nodes that differ or lack the item are shown but not selected.
- 🏷️ **Outbound renames** — renaming an outbound updates the routing rules and balancers that reference it.
- 🗑️ **Safer deletes** — deleting an outbound or balancer that a routing rule or balancer still uses asks for confirmation first.

## Reliability and compatibility

- A failed custom node does not stop the other selected nodes. The admin who made the change receives a notification with the node name and the error.
- Inbounds are not affected by the custom node changes.

## Upgrade notes

> No database migration is required. Rebecca Node 1.6.1 remains the current node build, and no node update is needed for this release.
